mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over three months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand and increased corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months signals strengthening labor market conditions and increased corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over three months signals strengthening economic activity and increased corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals inflationary pressures, leading the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
